newsitem.title: FINLAND: ENSO ACQUIRES TETRA PAK PRODUCTION LINE.
newsitem.headline: ENSO ACQUIRES TETRA PAK PRODUCTION LINE.

text.p: Finnish forestry group Enso Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had agreed with Tetra Pak Oy (Finland) on the transfer of Tetra Pak's board coating production line in Imatra to Enso on May 1.
The price of the deal was not given.

"Tetra Pak's line is situated in conjunction with Enso's Imatra mills. By adding it to its other coating lines Enso will be able to utilise its capacity in a more flexible way, thereby improving its productivity," it said.
Enso said it would continue to supply liquid packaging board to Tetra Pak. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
